definitions.gloss: outdoor activities; activities held outdoors; field activities
definitions.explanation: Activities conducted outside, especially organized educational, recreational, or military activities in natural settings.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{野外活動|やがいかつどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{野外活動|やがいかつどう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦キャンプ→キャンプ：03837_kyanpu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: We're going camping as a school outdoor activity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨天|うてん}→雨天：15325_uten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧、{野外活動|やがいかつどう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{中止|ちゅうし}→中止：03481_chuushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{可能性|かのうせい}→可能性：04818_kanousei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In case of rain, the outdoor activities may be canceled.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{野外|やがい}→野外：17152_yagai⟧ (outdoors; open air) and ⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧ (activity). Frequently used in school and scouting contexts for organized outdoor programs such as camping, hiking, and nature observation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {野外活動|やがいかつどう}⟦センター→センター：03854_sentaa⟧: outdoor activity center
- {野外活動|やがいかつどう}⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧: outdoor activity facility
- {野外活動|やがいかつどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to conduct outdoor activities
- ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{野外活動|やがいかつどう}: school outdoor activities

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦アウトドア→アウトドア：10695_autodoa⟧: outdoor — loanword; more casual and lifestyle-oriented
- ⟦{屋外|おくがい}→屋外：04136_okugai⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧: outdoor activity — similar but ⟦{屋外|おくがい}→屋外：04136_okugai⟧ simply means "outside a building," while ⟦{野外|やがい}→野外：17152_yagai⟧ implies a natural setting
- ⟦{課外活動|かがいかつどう}→課外活動：08605_kagaikatsudou⟧: extracurricular activities — activities outside regular classes, not necessarily outdoors
